blogs.title: The Adnexal Mass That Wasn’t: Pedunculated Cystic Fibroid Mimicking Endometrioma in Pregnancy
blogs.description: Imaging and exam pearls to distinguish decidualized endometriomas from cystic degenerating or pedunculated subserosal leiomyomas in pregnancy. Covers the bimanual exam, color Doppler clues (bridging vessels), the ‘stalk sign,’ and non-contrast MRI features that help avoid mislabeling uterine pathology as adnexal disease.

blogs.title: CA-125 in Pregnancy: Don’t Take the Bait
blogs.description: How to interpret tumor markers when evaluating pelvic masses during gestation. Reviews physiologic CA-125 fluctuations, why single cutoffs mislead, the limited utility of risk algorithms in pregnancy, and how to integrate trends with ultrasound/MRI to prevent overcalling malignancy and overtreatment.

blogs.title: When Dyspnea Isn’t PE: Mass-Effect Respiratory Failure from Giant Fibroids
blogs.description: A diagnostic pitfall: second-trimester dyspnea driven by massive uterine masses causing restrictive mechanics and diaphragmatic splinting. Practical bedside assessment, when to image the chest, positional strategies, analgesia, and red flags that push you toward operative management instead of empiric cardiopulmonary workups.

blogs.title: Operating in the Second Trimester: Indications, Timing, and Tactics for Pelvic Masses
blogs.description: Decision-making for non-obstetric surgery in pregnancy: when symptoms (pain, torsion, rupture risk, infection, mass-effect dyspnea) trump expectant management. Compares laparoscopy vs laparotomy selection, perioperative fetal heart assessment, positioning and anesthesia pearls, MRI without gadolinium for planning, and why prophylactic tocolysis/progesterone remains controversial.

blogs.title: Myomectomy During Pregnancy: Take One, Leave One
blogs.description: Rational, targeted surgical strategy illustrated by resecting a twisted pedunculated leiomyoma while preserving an intramural-subserosal lesion to protect the pregnancy. Discusses hemorrhage planning, uterine repair, intraoperative ultrasound for fetal assessment, transfusion readiness, and postoperative monitoring.

blogs.title: Planning the Delivery with Big Fibroids: Mapping the Road to Cesarean
blogs.description: How size, number, and location of leiomyomas dictate delivery mode. Practical imaging-based planning for obstructed labor risk, timing elective cesarean after antenatal myomectomy, scar considerations, and leveraging postpartum regression to defer definitive surgery.

blogs.title: Pregnant, Infected, and Anemic: Perioperative Housekeeping That Changes Outcomes
blogs.description: Managing the details that matter: antibiotic selection for pregnancy-safe UTI treatment and surgical prophylaxis, interpreting inflammatory markers in pregnancy, IV iron and transfusion thresholds around non-obstetric surgery, and post-op follow-up to optimize maternal recovery while safeguarding the fetus.
